answer: The plume counter is kept in delta and crystal shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 20 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 20 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 27 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
